jane_customer: Hey team — hitting a production issue since 09:12 UTC. Our rerank calls are intermittently returning 429s and when they don't 429, the scores are garbage (lots of 0.0). Downstream sorting breaks. Anyone seen this?

maria_support: Sorry you're seeing that — can you paste the exact error payload and any headers from the response? Also how big are your batches?

jane_customer: curl response body: `{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","code":429,"message":"rerank requests per-minute quota exceeded"}`
Headers we got: `X-RateLimit-Rerank-Limit: 600`, `X-RateLimit-Rerank-Remaining: 0`, `X-RateLimit-Rerank-Reset: 1977654350`, `Retry-After: 28`. Batch size = 200 candidates per request, sending ~30 reqs/min during spike.

maria_support: thx. Did you notice if the 0.0 scores happen immediately after a 429 or also independently?

jane_customer: Both. Some requests return 429. Others return 200 with body like `{"scores":[0,0,0,0,...], "order":"unchanged"}`. We log timing: the 0-score responses correlate with high request rate but not 100% overlap.

jon_engineer: pinging eng-runtime. Quick note: rerank has a separate quota/ingestion path than generation — if the quota is hit mid-batch the service may short-circuit scoring for that batch and return placeholder scores. That would explain zeros. Can you attach a minimal repro curl?

jane_customer: repro (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"input":"How to reset password?","candidates":["doc1","doc2",...,"doc200"],"max_results":10}'
```
We started seeing the issue after we ramped from 5 req/min to ~30 req/min this morning.

jon_engineer: ok. Two actionable items: 1) temporarily drop batch size to 50 and cap to 10 req/min to avoid hitting per-minute rerank quota; 2) we'll add better handling so partial quota hits return 429 consistently instead of returning placeholder scores. Can you try reducing batch size and confirm?

lee_ml: adding context from ML side: when scoring path is aborted and we fall back, the system currently emits default score 0.0 for all candidates to indicate no scoring performed. That behavior was meant to be internal but I see why it breaks your downstream logic. We should either fail fast (429) or return nulls with an error flag. We'll change product behavior.

jane_customer: Temporary mitigation applied (batch->50, throttled). Error rate dropped but still saw 1/20 responses with 0-scores. Any ETA on a fix? This is impacting search relevancy in prod.

maria_support: Filed internal issue INF-4821 and escalated to oncall. Eng oncall (jon) assigned. Also opening a support ticket with priority P1.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1977654321 linked to INF-4821. Notifying infra-oncall.

jon_engineer: Investigating — I see bursts where X-RateLimit-Rerank-Remaining goes negative for a short window due to eventual consistency in our quota counter. We'll add a guard to reject at ingress to avoid silent default-score fallthrough. I'll post a patch/rollout plan in ~2 hours.

lee_ml: For short-term, we can change client-side recommendation: if you receive `scores` all equal (0 or identical), treat as a transient error and retry with exponential backoff and smaller batch. We'll update the docs.

jane_customer: thanks. Please confirm once the guard is live and send steps to detect if a response is a placeholder vs real scores so we can put a filter in our pipeline.

maria_support: Will do. I've added a repro log to the ticket and asked eng to include a deterministic header `X-Rerank-Placeholder: true` on placeholder responses until fixed. We'll update you here when PR is deployed. :thumbsup:

jon_engineer: patch rolled to staging (rollout id r-1978). Plan: 1) ingress quota check consistent; 2) respond 429 when quota exceeded; 3) remove placeholder default-scores. Deploying to prod in 2h after monitoring. I'll post a follow-up.

jane_customer: Appreciate the quick response. Leaving throttling in place until confirmation.

maria_support: Follow-up: PROD rollout scheduled at 11:45 UTC. We'll monitor for any regressions and close ticket when you confirm no more placeholder scores.

jane_customer: ok — I'll report back after the window.

jon_engineer: Follow-up after deploy: initial metrics show placeholder-score responses dropped to 0. Post-deploy note: if you still see 429s, obey Retry-After header. We'll send a postmortem if anything unexpected comes up.

jane_customer: Confirmed — no placeholder-score responses in the last 45 minutes. Thanks everyone!
